_comment: Tracked company names that must never be matched against a WARN filing.
WARN rows carry a job-site employer name, so a common word matches the
wrong business constantly. Texas WARN alone produced 'Wise' (the tracked
company is a UK fintech with no 2019 Fort Worth site), 'Tempus' (Tempus AI
is Chicago-based) and fourteen 'Compass' notices averaging two employees.
Same rule as scripts/edgar/aliases.json: if a name cannot be told apart
from an unrelated employer, it does not get matched at all.
